exposure: vaginal bleeding counseling provided (timing, content, language concordance, thematic content)
outcome: issues with access to postpartum products
variation in accurate and respectful care
cohort: 15 birthing parents and their companions during their postnatal inpatient unit stay at a tertiary hospital.
finding: Vaginal bleeding counseling showed significant variation in timing, content, and language concordance, often delivered close to discharge, with observed issues in product access and inconsistent, respectful care.
cross-section timing: during the postnatal inpatient unit stay, specifically from 12 hours before hospital discharge
